name: AgeLocator Age Gate
author: Mark Moran

sections.description:
Free Age Gate for WordPress

AgeLocator Age Gate provides a simple, effective age verification solution for WordPress sites that need to confirm visitor ages before displaying content.

What it does:
✅ Age Confirmation – Visitors confirm they meet minimum age requirements
✅ Content Protection – Blocks content until age is verified
✅ Compliance Helper – Assists with basic age-related compliance needs

Perfect for:
– Adult content websites
– Age-restricted product pages
– Alcohol/tobacco related sites
– Dating and social platforms
– Any site requiring age confirmation

Features:
– Simple yes/no age confirmation
– Custom age limit 18
– Responsive design for all devices
– Session memory (won’t ask again)
– Custom messaging and styling
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Go to Settings > AgeLocator Age Gate
sections.faq:
Is this legally compliant?

This plugin provides basic age confirmation. For full legal compliance, consult with legal counsel about your specific requirements.

Does it actually verify ages?

No, this is an honor-system age gate where users self-declare their age. For document verification, consider our premium service.

Will users have to verify on every visit?

No, the plugin remembers verification status during the browser session.
